_readme: Edit this file to change flavours, sizes and prices. The server uses it to check and price every preorder, and the website reads it too.

customPrice._note: Used for custom sizes: base + perGram x grams. With these numbers 50 g = 50, 100 g = 80 and 150 g = 110, so custom sizes line up with the presets.

paymentNote: No payment online. Ed confirms your order by phone or message, and you pay on pickup or delivery.

flavours.name: Original
flavours.notes: Soy, garlic and a slow kiss of natural smoke. The one everyone starts with.

flavours.name: Black Pepper
flavours.notes: A heavy crust of cracked black pepper over deep, savoury beef.

flavours.name: Garlic
flavours.notes: Big garlic flavour, mellow all the way through. No heat, all depth.

flavours.name: Spicy
flavours.notes: Chili that creeps up on you. For people who ask for extra.

flavours.name: BBQ
flavours.notes: Brown sugar and smoke glazed onto every strip.
